Option B would move that hot path, which runs in group 0 by design (`ci.yml:2136-2138`). Option C would make the same trade-off and change more. Group 3 runs the two #7689 steps (`ci.yml:2504-2514`). So group 1 has the most headroom. `tests-heal-plan-and-validation` has hit its budget before (#7690), so it is a poor target.

It runs the same three `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/<file>.py` commands, unchanged and in the same order, under `set -euo pipefail`.
